description: Record money a worker spent on a job, with the receipt photo. Parts received on a purchase order are already job cost; when the vendor matches a received purchase order on the job, possible_po_duplicates lists it so you can ask before keeping both. The worker types the amount and tax from the receipt; core never reads or fills in amounts. spent_on defaults to today in the shop's time zone.

amount_minor.description: Total paid in cents, typed by the worker from the receipt.

tax_minor.description: Tax part of amount_minor, typed by the worker. Default 0.

name: expenses_add
